caption: The drawing shows a detailed depiction of a historical dress, displayed on a faceless, headless mannequin. The dress is predominantly light yellow with pink, red, blue, and green floral embroidery along the bodice's seams, sleeve cuffs, and the sides of the skirt. The bodice features a fitted shape with a pointed front waist and blue lace trim around the neckline and sleeve ends. The sleeves have ruffles at the elbows, accented by the blue lace. The outer skirt is draped and festooned over an underlying petticoat or underskirt that is shaded in a light gray and decorated with an intricate line drawing of floral and leaf motifs. In the upper right corner, there is an unfinished pencil sketch of the dress's back view, showing the outline without color or details. The drawing appears on a cream-colored background.
title: Dress
